Rishi / team,

Thanks — below is the internal purge workflow we will execute for BW-Prod-2025. I’ve attached the internal playbook (purge_playbook_v2.pdf) and an audit CSV template (audit_template.csv).

Summary of steps (high-level):
1) Triage & Scope
   - Confirm account id and workspace tag: BW-Prod-2025 (acct: bw-4389).
   - Identify all storage locations: S3 prefixes (s3://redwood-prod/bw-4389/requests/), embeddings index shard ids (idx-bw-4389-*), and KV cache snapshot keys (kv:cache:bw-4389:*).

2) Create immutable deletion job (request id: DEL-20260318-BW-001) and snapshot metadata for audit before destructive ops. Snapshot stored in encrypted audit bucket with restricted access.

3) Flush in-memory caches and live KV caches (immediate). This ensures no ephemeral tokens remain in serving memory.

4) Delete persisted artifacts
   - Object delete (S3 DeleteObjects) for matched prefixes; run lifecycle override for multipart remnants.
   - Remove embeddings and index shards: mark shards for deletion and remove pointers from search index; then run compaction to eliminate residual vectors.
   - Purge message-level inference logs from the aggregated logging pipeline (Kafka topics and long-term storage).

5) Backups & Snapshots
   - Identify backups containing the data (daily snapshots last 730 days) and either redact or schedule targeted deletion if retention prevents immediate removal. For hosted accounts, we overwrite the relevant segments where possible and flag the rest for retention-controlled purge (expected within 72 hours).

6) Key rotation & post-op validation
   - If requested, rotate any encryption keys used for the workspace to prevent future restore from remaining encrypted backups.
   - Run validation queries and lightweight membership scans to confirm no matching records remain in primary and secondary stores.

7) Audit deliverables (post-completion)
   - Audit CSV (see attached template) with rows: object_path, object_type, deletion_timestamp, deletion_method, request_id, deletion_hash.
   - Signed confirmation email + link to internal job trace and ticket (INF-9204).

SLA and timeline:
- Live cache flush: immediate (within 1 hour).
- Removal of persisted objects and indices: target completion 48–72 hours depending on index compaction and backup constraints.
- Audit package delivery: within 24 hours of completion.

Notes/edge cases:
- If BrightWave requests deletion of any exported model artifacts used for fine-tuning, that is a separate workflow with longer lead time; please confirm.
- For on-prem or Private deployments, steps differ; please confirm this is a hosted account.

Attachments: purge_playbook_v2.pdf (internal), audit_template.csv

I will create DEL-20260318-BW-001 and start the job as soon as Caroline confirms 'proceed'.

Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
